newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sodra raises pulp price to $580 a tonne from $520.
newsitem.headline: Sodra raises pulp price to $580 a tonne from $520.

text.p: Swedish forestry cooperative Sodra said on Friday that it had raised its pulp price to $580 a tonne from $520, effective immediately.
Sodra said it had raised its price for short fibre pulp to 460 ECU a tonne from 400 ECU.
"I can say that we are raising pulp prices to $580 ... and we are raising the price of short fibre pulp to 460 Ecu," Sodra's marketing director Hans Burmeister told Reuters.
Burmeister said the possibilities for further increases were good with other players in the market also lifting prices and the market strengthening.
"We think there is a good chance that prices will continue to go up," he said.
